text: Breakfast at Roscoe's, lunch at the Ivy Dinner at Nobu, the Ladoo was lively After that, at the Cribs, will you find me? Where we got a lab to record it all? Blimey! You know what I mean? The crib is sick, we call it the Coach Which stands for the crib of all cribs Puppies! By now I think you'll get it straight You could consider me to Benny Chase But without the pretty face Will the Beast got sponsored by Bacardi? Nah, he ain't a turtle
